title: Knowledge Garden
scope: A selected, source-reviewed map of project work. It is not an exhaustive Library inventory, a full conversation archive or a model of everything a person knows.
rules: Hierarchy is navigation; typed relations have their own scope.
Related material is not evidence merely because it is linked.
Source contracts, reported results, local candidates and new implementation have distinct statuses.
Working sets are proposals; selection carries no authority or evidence promotion.
Private source documents and original personal conversation records remain outside this public catalog.
Each project retains its own admission rules and scientific claim boundary.

relations.scope: The described routing workflow requires recoverable source identities and handles.
Working-set proposals adapt the reviewed routing contract; they do not run the Master package.
Use keyboard, source and acceptance principles to evaluate this interface.
An on-demand companion is a possible retrieval destination, with no active session or authority transfer.
A local repair candidate must be reconciled before adoption in the inspected public version.
Selecting task material is distinct from representing the whole person.
Preserve authorship and explicit turn classification when routing learning.
Evaluate a summary by preserved consequential meaning and reconstruction effort.
Keep source identity and admission history when moving a material into a working set.
Recheck the exact interface and recoverable practice before using a companion capability.
Try a bounded claim ledger and counter-probes within Moonshot project gates.
Reconcile stored finite output boundaries before a stronger claim.
Exact byte transport is one candidate obligation; semantic preservation needs its own check.
Shared carrier navigation does not establish identical codecs or evidence.
A proposed carrier comparison must preserve the section-specific obligation.
Context reconstruction can motivate a bounded comparison without establishing learning success.
Explore whether reusable memory reduces future cost under the same correctness and resource bounds.
Control structures and finite routing records can supply candidate tests, not shared proof.
Use observed participant and assistive-technology acceptance for the finding workflow.
Evaluate the workbook workflow with its intended keyboard and screen-reader environment.
Compare explicit API contract and capability labeling practices without importing private service schemas.
The repository initialization and current navigation checkpoint connect these workstreams; runtime import status is separate.
The public cooperation lab carries the candidate patches; it does not deploy the candidate into Conscience64.
Context interpretation and a stipulated finite decision model stay separate even when linked for navigation.
The source-described search audit uses the pinned sibling transport implementation.
The D1 register grammar retains comparison and fallback to the parent tree grammar without sharing an evidence scope.
Investigate the unresolved historical route without inventing definitions or causal influence.
Keep supplied-coordinate checks separate from the geometric claim and its missing dependencies.
The frozen-period example is included in the published SP1024-1 lab.
